output.brief:
The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Build 7.4.0 already crashed at about 2% from 2 Sep, before the flag ramp, while 7.3.2 stayed at about 0.7%. Only 7.4.0 users can have the flag, so the flag and the build are mixed together. Among 7.4.0 users, a random holdout without the flag crashes at 1.98% against 2.10% with it. That difference is small and not statistically distinguishable from zero. The leading crash cluster (41%) is in the Pixelda image library upgrade, which the flag does not touch. The app-store console, which is independent of the crash-reporting SDK, shows the same gap, so it is not a counting artifact. Device mix, usage and the 9 Sep backend deployment don't explain it.

Don't turn the flag off and release 7.4.0 to 100% on Friday. That would ship the real problem to everyone. Hold 7.4.0 at 25% and fix the Pixelda decoding crash. Keep the flag holdout running, and widen it if you want an answer faster, to settle whether the flag adds a few tenths of a point. Don't roll back the crash-reporting SDK. Reworking the canvas memory handling now is premature. I'm fairly confident in this; the remaining uncertainty is the small flag effect.
